arithmetic: For every split-color unresolved F state, find one target affine-lattice witness in an expanded exponent box up to radius six and classify whether its overflow coordinates lie in the selected Fourier-active support.
scope_note: Finite witness-support boundary. A missing witness beyond radius six is not a target nonexistence result. The support split tests whether a two-active-direction overflow to carrier-height implication is even compatible with the selected witnesses.
